notes.title: ⏰ New Update Alarm for PC & Steam Deck
notes.content:
Wake up, dreamers! Our first update has arrived.

With over 200,000 player deaths (and counting), we figured it was time to give you a few more tools to fight back… or at least die in slightly more comfort.

This update brings quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, a touch more light, and some important fixes for those of you playing on Steam Deck. Let’s dive in:

🌕[b]What’s New[/b]

[list]
[*] Locked 60 FPS option for those who prefer their nightmares smooth as butter
[*] FPS Canvas now scales with resolution (no numbers for ants!)
[*] Automatic language detection will pick the right localization based on your Steam UI
[*] Chapter 1, Level 15 — Music no longer restarts every time you die. You’re welcome! 
[*] Chapter 3, Level 8 — Scene lighting updated to make that one item easier to spot
[/list]

🌓[b]What’s Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed issues with Steam Deck optimization not applying
[*] Cleaned up control hint layout for Steam Deck (shout-out to @Amferatus for the catch!)
[*] Fixed inconsistent font sizes in Portuguese
[*] Fixed typos in the German localization
[*] Chapter 3, Level 16 — Fixed a bug where music would stop permanently after dying at the end (it was pretty creepy)
[*] Fixed a few other behind-the-scenes bugs. Some harmless, some… not so much.
[/list]

One more thing: if you have bought and enjoyed Through the Nightmares, please consider leaving us a review! Steam reviews matter even in the dream world. Trust us, we know.

[b]Thank you for dying, retrying, and dreaming with us!
– Sandman Team[/b]

notes.title: 200,000+ Deaths and Counting
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re excited to announce that in just three weeks since launch, Through the Nightmares players have collectively racked up [b]over 200,000 player deaths[/b]. And the number keeps rising! 

Whether you charged at Morpheus head-on or slipped up on one of the (many) tricky platforms, every spectacular demise has been making us happy as the developer. We’re love to see many of you embrace the challenge (and often the agony) of escaping the Nightmare. THANK YOU!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266210/Through_the_Nightmares/

Think you can escape the Nightmare’s death tally? Through the Nightmares is available now on Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, and Switch. Join Sandman on his adventure, test your skills, and see if you can beat the dream!

And one more thing… We’re putting the finishing touches on a big new update, which is coming your way in just a few days. Stay tuned!

[b]Until then, sweet dreams,
— Sandman Team[/b]

notes.title: Through the Nightmares Launches June 19th
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It still feels a bit unreal to write this, but it’s official:

[b]Through the Nightmares launches on June 19th.[/b]

We’ve spent years working on this game — chasing wild dreams (and sometimes losing our minds). If you’ve played the demo, gave feedback, or even added it to your wishlist, you’ve been part of this journey. Thank you.

To celebrate, here’s a fresh look at what’s coming:

[previewyoutube=w5nhkXcrv-c;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ll be back soon with more updates. But for now, we just want to say:

This is happening. The game is finished. And we can’t wait for you to finally play it.

See you in the nightmares on June 19th!

[b]Sweet dreams,
Sandman Team[/b]

notes.title: Through the Nightmares arrives June 2025! Check out our new trailer on IGN
notes.content:
Hey dreamers!

We’ve been dying to share this news: [b]Through the Nightmares is officially launching in June 2025 on Steam and other platforms![/b]

To celebrate, our brand-new trailer is now live on IGN’s YouTube channel, showcasing an action-packed glimpse of Sandman, Morpheus, and some of the setpieces waiting for you in the game.

[previewyoutube=S1hjMlB1vSw;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve also treated our demo to a fresh update — go check it out and let us know what you think!
And that’s not all: we have a sparkling new cover art, courtesy of our friends at Pingle, who will be bringing Through the Nightmares to consoles. Don’t you just love that yellow?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37247855/3bd069598ff879724014a32a77c871c6901f95da.png[/img]

(The most eagle-eyed of you will notice we’ve also updated the game’s logo. It’s the same idea, just… nicer.)

One more thing… We have a cool new studio logo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37247855/3f8554e013f1d977416ae01e1e44368aa1abdbdb.png[/img]

It still feels surreal — we’ve been working on TTN as a three-person team since 2016, and it’s hard to believe we’re this close to [strike]waking up[/strike] having the game out. Thank you for sticking with us on this journey!

We’ve got some more announcements to make before June, so keep your eyes peeled. In the meantime, [url=https://discord.com/invite/eraxzJB]join our Discord[/url] if you’d like an inside look at the final stretch of development!

[b]Sweet dreams,
Sandman Team[/b]

notes.title: Oops, We Did It Again: Release 0.15.0 - Game Fixes and Polishing
notes.content:
The trip to [b]Gamescom[/b] was beneficial for us in more ways than one, as it helped us uncover several bugs that we hadn't encountered before. So, we back home from this awesome festival and decided to create a patch, and to make things more interesting, we added a couple of features that were already in development at the time we began working on the patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37247855/b916d361961beed2624730bc8be489650f331b89.jpg[/img]

[h2]General Updates:[/h2]
😎 Polished the Lvl7 cutscene
😎 Added logic to skip the initial cutscene. This is a feature we've always felt was missing during exhibitions and showcases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37247855/b81f2e6629981cb003192ef9af25dce1a670c7da.jpg[/img]

[h2]Sounds Improvements:[/h2]
🎧 Updated the in-game music! We are currently in the process of finding our unique audio style and experimenting with various soundscapes and moods. This isn't the final music, but you can have a listen and give us your feedback on how you like it!
🎧 Added sounds for character introductions. Not it is not completely silince.
🎧 Updated a significant number of sounds across the game.

[previewyoutube=NZOvH1jwAgs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
🪓 Removed unfinished languages that accidentally appeared in previous builds (🤦‍♂️)
🪓 Fixed shifting camera angles if you die at the very end of the second part of lvl7
🪓 Fixed the ability to die after finishing lvl7
🪓 Fixed random tutorial bugs from analytics
🪓 Fixed wrong trigger positions on lvl4
🪓 Fixed gamepad tutorial for Hit that never disappears even after passing it
🪓 Fixed hiding Tutorial after user death

[h2]So...[/h2]

It seems that the game has become more stable, which means we can again engage in the creative part of development. See you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37247855/07ea64434c3046522efbe37d9de67c4697453b33.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Updated Demo for Independence Day of Ukraine
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings 🖐️[/h3]

[b]Independence Day[/b], especially at this moment, holds profound significance for every Ukrainian. Therefore, our team has done the great job on the game and decided to update the demo in honor of this occasion. You can play it right now!

We have improved the convenience and accessibility of the game, as many of you have requested. Additionally, we have translated the game into Polish, introduced support for multiple save slots, and implemented a multitude of minor changes. More details are provided below.
[h3]🛠️General:[/h3]
[list]
✅Added Polish localization
✅Added support for multiple save slots
✅Added or reworked sounds for various mechanics
[/list]
[h3]🎮Controls and Accessibility:[/h3]
[list]
✅Added the ability to customize keyboard controls
✅Added vibration for the gamepad
✅Added a warning about gamepad disconnection
✅Created distinct interfaces for Xbox and PS gamepads (including tutorials)
✅Added LED lighting for DualShock 4 and DualSense gamepads
[/list]
[h3]🔧Other:[/h3]
[list]
✅Numerous alterations have been made to the second and third chapters, which we are eager to showcase, but cannot due to spoilers.
[/list]
Make sure to [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/eraxzJB]join our Discord server[/url][/b] for the opportunity to become a beta tester and to be among the first to know development news.

https://discord.com/invite/eraxzJB


Thank you for being with us! Glory to Ukraine!
SandmanTeam

notes.title: 🦇 Halloween Event - last change to get the flask!
notes.content:
[b]It's Halloween time![/b] And we, as the creators of the game about nightmares, just couldn't stay away, so we decided to make a themed event for you!

We also dislike that there is absolutely no customization in our game, so we decided to make an experiment and give you the opportunity to get the [b]first unique resurrection flask skin[/b]!

[b]You need to download the demo, find 7 pumpkins on the 7 levels, smash them, and tell all your friends about the game![/b] The last point is optional, but if you do, in addition to the flask, you will receive our many thanks! That's all, the flask is yours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37247855/4c5d21d79b87e1f52c1e4c1f8339a687b8bd7b4d.png[/img]

The event will only be available for a few days, so don't delay.

If you like the game, [b]add it to your wishlist[/b]. And if you have any thoughts on other flask skins or customization types, be sure to share your ideas on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/eraxzJB]Discord[/url].

Happy Halloween!
